visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Restrained use. `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#102B4E]/60 border border-[#D6B574]/20` for sticky headers and elevated cards. Never fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Sophisticated ambient shadows. `shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(7,20,38,0.5)]` with slight gold inner glow.
visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom cursor on desktop: small circular outline with a solid gold dot inside (`#D6B574`), tracking mouse movement.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Elegant, restrained gradients. No full-screen neon. `bg-gradient-to-br from-[#071426] to-[#102B4E]`.
visual_enhancers.loading: Premium loading animation with FGI monogram (stylized initials 'FGI' with a gold shimmer effect).

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous whitespace. Use `py-24` or `py-32` for sections, `gap-8` to `gap-12` in grids.
grids_and_layouts.services_grid: 6 cards: 3-column grid on desktop (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`).
grids_and_layouts.audience_cards: 4 flip cards: 2-column or 4-column grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`).
grids_and_layouts.timeline_steps: 6-step timeline for 'How It Works', alternating layout on desktop.

motion.transitions: Smooth section reveals on scroll (`framer-motion` initial opacity 0, y 20).
motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (`-translate-y-2`) with increased shadow and gold border opacity.
motion.flip_cards: CSS 3D transform (`rotateY(180deg)`) triggered on click with 700-900ms duration. Must preserve 3D (`transform-style: preserve-3d`).
motion.reduced_motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` media query for all Framer Motion and CSS animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against Midnight Navy meets APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.aria: Use `aria-hidden` on decorative 3D elements and flip card backfaces when not flipped.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Use Framer Motion for section reveals, but keep them professional and smooth. No bouncy or jarring animations.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
DO NOT apply universal transition like `transition: all`.
DO NOT center align the app container in the css file.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute for testing.
Ensure the hero CTA 'Start Your Work' smooth-scrolls to the Signature Flip Card and automatically flips it to the form.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for professional minimal iconography.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a single-page React/Vite/Tailwind app with the sections listed in the problem statement. Follow the exact color hex codes provided. Create custom components for the 3D CSS flip cards. Use Resend logic in the background if possible, but mock the frontend states perfectly. Respect the constraints of no fake data. Build the 'Privacy Policy', 'Terms', and '404' as simple route pages. Use `react-router-dom` for the multi-page feel despite being primarily a SPA landing page. Add the custom cursor script or component. DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
